en.title: Longest Run of Powered-On Machines After At Most k Range Flips
en.description:
One operation chooses any contiguous range and flips every 0 and 1 in it; at most k operations are allowed. Find the length of the longest contiguous run of 1s at the end. Operations may overlap, and you do not have to use all k.

The standard I/O, examples and editorial were written independently by this site; ranges explicitly marked as this site's are not the source's original constraints.
en.input: The first line contains the binary string; the second line contains k. 1≤length≤200000, 1≤k≤200000.
en.output: Output a single integer, the answer.
en.explanation: The answers are 4, 4 and 8; flipping the last two runs of 0s directly gives length 8, with no need for the complicated overlapping operations used in the source.
hints: Use a sliding window that counts the runs of 0s inside it, keep that count within k, and maximize the length. Flipping each run of 0s once turns it entirely into 1s.
